data.summary_en: Preregistered re-execution audits coding-agent evaluations: rerunning 1,929 Darwin Gödel Machine–archived evaluations preserved best-agent selection and system-variant ranking, but SWE-bench Pro v1’s offline option did not reject 59 accepted Go patches with changed scoring configurations; exploratory unweighted upper bound 4.95%, and 3% exposed-patch risk remains unresolved.
